_meta.note: Statewide recurring events on the Michigan abolition calendar. Each entry represents an annual observance that Abolish Abortion Michigan calls its network to keep — typically prayer, lament, education, and/or peaceful witness. Local abolitionists host the observance in their own city (church, capitol steps, Signal group). Add specific rallies, hearings, or dated events here as they come up; anything present in this file is rendered on /events and emits full Event JSON-LD.

events.name: Michigan Day of Lament — Anniversary of Prop 3

location.name: Statewide — hosted locally in Michigan cities

events.shortDescription: Statewide day of prayer, lament, and public witness marking the anniversary of Michigan Proposal 3 (Reproductive Freedom for All).
events.longDescription: Every year on November 8, Abolish Abortion Michigan calls its network to a day of prayer and lament for the passage of Prop 3 (2022), which enshrined a constitutional right to abortion in Michigan. Local abolitionists host the day in their own city — at a church, at the county courthouse, at their state legislator's district office, or in their Signal group. The purpose is not despair but sober remembrance and renewed commitment to equal-protection legislation that treats every preborn image-bearer as a person under Michigan law.
events.audience: Christians, abolitionists, and any Michigan resident who rejects the pretense that a majority vote can strip preborn children of legal personhood.
events.howToJoin: Contact us to host or join a local observance in your city. Details, prayer guides, and printable materials go out through the Signal group.

events.name: Michigan Day of Prayer for the Preborn — Roe Anniversary

location.name: Statewide — hosted locally in Michigan cities and churches

events.shortDescription: Annual day of prayer, teaching, and peaceful presence on the anniversary of Roe v. Wade (January 22).
events.longDescription: January 22 remains the anniversary of the Roe v. Wade decision that first federalized the abortion regime. Even after Dobbs and even after Michigan's own Prop 3, the date is a fixture on the abolition calendar. Abolish Abortion Michigan calls churches to teach on the imago Dei that day, calls families to pray, and calls Michiganders to a peaceful, lawful witness at an abortion facility in their area. Local hosts choose the format — a Sunday-morning sermon series, a Wednesday-evening prayer meeting, a lunchtime prayer walk, a Signal-group study.
events.audience: Michigan churches, families, and abolition groups.
events.howToJoin: Ask your pastor to teach the topic on the Sunday nearest Jan 22, or coordinate a local prayer gathering through our Signal group.
